main_body: A grey iron mine cart body with a thin light rim on top, a dark front interior and wheels below. A few gold ore nuggets sit on the rim.
top_band: Single light grey row at row 4 (L=170, #a3acb5), flanked by 1-row mid-grey steps (L=124-126). It is not a surface of several consecutive rows. It fades straight into the dark body from row 6 (L=82) to rows 7-9 (L=61).
evidence: The column reads as one continuous light-to-dark gradient (170, 126, 82, 61, 61, 82) with no step of 25 L or more separating a top from a front face. The light rim is only 1-2 rows, which is the 'rim only' failure. No ellipse or interior surface is visible from above, so the opening is not shown. The dark rounded area is a painted front panel, not a view into the cart. The gold nuggets sit above the rim and are not a visible heap of contents.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 9 distinct colours and 9 per tile, against 38-40 distinct and 17-20 per tile in the references, so it is much sparser. 92% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, which gives a cold black/grey sticker-like outline instead of tinted material-tone edges. The grey ramp has about 5 steps but little grain or per-part variation. There are no large flat fills, but the piece is clearly thinner than the references.
